title: Sharron T Probable NDE 7451
content: March 10, 2014, I was taken to Good Samaritan Hospital by my husband because I was very sick. I had somehow been exposed to a bacterial pneumonia, which had dumped its toxins into my bloodstream. I was put on life support and had nurses at my bedside constantly, because the alarms kept going off due to my oxygen intake being too low. I don't remember any of this, but what I do vividly remember is being in a very special place. There was no tunnel or bright light; instead, a very creamy white/yellow light, like very early morning, was everywhere. The colors were so vivid and the layers of everything went much deeper than our typical 3D: it was more like 30x30D. It was so beautiful and calming that I knew I wanted to be here forever. There were people and animals as far as I could see. I could only see the head and shoulders of the people, but there were thousands and thousands of them and I realized I knew every one of them. On my right, with peripheral vision, I saw my younger brother who had passed in 2001. Behind me, also to my right, was my husband's father, who had also passed in November 1998. He touched my shoulders, turned me around, and said, ‘Clay deserves to be happy; you both deserve to be happy. So you have to go back now.’ Then he turned me around and gave me a gentle push. I remember the love and compassion. The first thing I remember was the respiratory nurse telling me to cough so he could remove the tube in my throat. I am still dazzled by what I had experienced. While I am not ready to die, I no longer fear the ending, because I know.
